definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when meeting or parting from someone.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{挨拶|あいさつ}をしました。
{先生|せんせい}に{挨拶|あいさつ}してください。
{新年|しんねん}の{挨拶|あいさつ}を{送|おく}りました。

notes:
{挨拶|あいさつ} refers to greetings and salutations.

COMMON GREETINGS:
- おはようございます: Good morning
- こんにちは: Hello (daytime)
- こんばんは: Good evening
- さようなら: Goodbye

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {挨拶|あいさつ}をする: to greet
- {挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わす: to exchange greetings
- {自己|じこ}{紹介|しょうかい}の{挨拶|あいさつ}: self-introduction

CULTURAL NOTE: Greetings are very important in Japanese culture and often accompanied by bowing.
